ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in recent Minnesota fraud cases, including the Housing Stabilization Fraud scheme and the Feeding Our Future fraud case.
questions: How did the perpetrators launder the money?
What were the weaknesses in the system that allowed the fraud to occur?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of how these fraud schemes operate and identify potential weaknesses in the system.
